EntityCodexEntryDef.label: deep one
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Amphibious servants of the deep that raid coastal settlements for captives.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: mi-go
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Winged fungoid scholars from the void, armed with strange casting weapons.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: shoggoth
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Shapeless protoplasmic labour-beasts that crush whatever stands in their way.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: dark young
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Spawn of Shub-Niggurath: walking groves of tentacles, hooves and drooling mouths.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: star vampire
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: An invisible sky-predator. It only shows itself once it has fed.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: chthonian
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Colossal burrowers that boil up from below to drag sacrifices into the pit.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: star-spawn of Cthulhu
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Eldest spawn of Cthulhu himself. Where it walks, madness follows.
